The weights we need are 1, 3, 9, 27, and 81 kg. These are the powers of 3 up to 81, which is the largest power of 3 less than 121. With these weights, we can measure any integer weight from 1 kg to 121 kg by placing the appropriate combination of weights on one side of the scale.

For example:
- To measure 1 kg, use the 1 kg weight.
- To measure 2 kg, use the 3 kg weight and place the 1 kg weight on the other side.
- To measure 4 kg, use the 3 kg and 1 kg weights on the same side.
- To measure 5 kg, use the 9 kg weight and place the 3 kg and 1 kg weights on the other side.
- And so on, up to 121 kg, which can be measured by using the 81 kg, 27 kg, 9 kg, 3 kg, and 1 kg weights on the same side.
